scripts.dev: concurrently -k "npm run dev:renderer" "wait-on tcp:5174 && electron electron/main.cjs"
scripts.package:linux:deb: npm run build && rm -rf ../../../../../dist/apps/linux/* && electron-builder --config electron-builder.json --linux deb --publish never --config.directories.output=../../../../../dist/apps/linux
scripts.install:linux:deb: set -e; DEB=$(find ../../../../../dist/apps/linux -maxdepth 1 -type f -name 'flypc-desktop-*.deb' -print0 | xargs -0 ls -t 2>/dev/null | head -n 1); if [ -z "$DEB" ]; then echo 'No deb found under dist/apps/linux'; exit 1; fi; sudo dpkg -r flypc-desktop flypc >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; sudo dpkg --purge flypc-desktop >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; sudo dpkg -i "$DEB"; sudo apt-get install -f -y; sudo dpkg --purge flypc-desktop >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
scripts.rebuild:install:linux: npm run package:linux:deb && npm run install:linux:deb
scripts.package:windows: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.json --win portable nsis --publish never --config.directories.output=../../../../../dist/apps/windows
scripts.package:linux: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.json --linux deb rpm --publish never --config.directories.output=../../../../../dist/apps/linux
